metadata.description: moxwel's Agent Skills for coding conventions and web frontends

plugins.name: moxwel-code-style
plugins.description: Language-agnostic code style: comments, file headers, doc comments, naming, control flow, robustness and error handling, line length, imports, Markdown documentation, git conventions, copy and briefs for delegating audits to subagents.

plugins.name: moxwel-standard-react-frontend
plugins.description: Standard for web frontends on Next.js App Router, React 19, Base UI, Tailwind v4 and Docker.

plugins.name: moxwel-agents
plugins.description: Generic agents the moxwel skills delegate to: a read-only auditor for one area of an audit and a sweeper that applies a change the user already picked across many files.
